title: DBT pass wrong value in cte models
answer:
The error is because you're passing a static string "level" to the macro, not the level value itself.

Since the level value is from table, you will need return a SQL statement from your macro to make the comparison occur in the database:

{% macro map_level_to_level_range(column_name) %}
CASE  
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '00 - 04'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 5 AND 10 THEN '05 - 09'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 10 AND 15 THEN '10 - 14'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 15 AND 20 THEN '15 - 19'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 20 AND 25 THEN '20 - 24'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 25 AND 30 THEN '25 - 29'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 30 AND 35 THEN '30 - 34'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 35 AND 40 THEN '35 - 39'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 40 AND 45 THEN '40 - 44'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 45 AND 50 THEN '45 - 49'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 50 AND 55 THEN '50 - 54'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 55 AND 60 THEN '55 - 59'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 60 AND 65 THEN '60 - 64'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 65 AND 75 THEN '65 - 74'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 75 AND 85 THEN '75 - 84'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 85 AND 100 THEN '85 - 99'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 100 AND 115 THEN '100 - 114'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 115 AND 130 THEN '115 - 129'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} BETWEEN 130 AND 150 THEN '130 - 149'
  WHEN {{ column_name }} >= 150 THEN '150+'
  ELSE '-1'
END
{% endmacro %}
